earth_contract_sources.content:
Interface: planning-packet.v2
planning-packet.v2 MUST include task_identifier and requirement_ids.
planning-packet.v2 SHOULD include operator_summary for human review.
Interface: telemetry-handshake.v1
telemetry-handshake.v1 SHALL include source_commit and generated_at.
telemetry-handshake.v1 MAY include debug_notes when available.

Interface: ops-control-channel.v1
ops-control-channel.v1 MUST rotate credentials every 24h.

Interface: fusion-evidence.v1
fusion-evidence.v1 required fields: evidence_ref and source_path.
fusion-evidence.v1 optional fields: source_sha256.
